odd.en: Grammatically it's odd. It's 'safe as houses' [plural] even though you're describing something singular.
odd.zh: 它的语法很奇怪。虽然你描述的是单数事物，但它用的却是复数形式的 'safe as houses'。

odd.en: The adjective weird means strange, odd or bizarre.
odd.zh: 形容词“weird”意思是奇怪的、古怪的或离奇的。

odd.en: On the other side of the world, in Melbourne Australia, in December of 1974, a bank clerk did notice something a little odd.
odd.zh: 在地球的另一端，1974 年 12 月的澳大利亚墨尔本，一名银行职员确实注意到了一些奇怪的事情。

odour.en: Without modern hygiene, strong body odours were just a part of life.
odour.zh: 在没有现代卫生条件的情况下，强烈的体味只是生活的一部分。

odour.en: So, local artisans began scenting the gloves with floral extracts to mask the unpleasant odour, to hide the nasty smell.
odour.zh: 因此，当地的工匠开始用花卉提取物给手套加香，以掩盖难闻的气味，隐藏刺鼻的臭味。
